source-support-sourcespans.definition: collection of selected span records attached to one support relation; a template placeholder is not a populated selection.
source-support-sourcespans.disposition: Retain the collection boundary so separately selected materials do not collapse into one unsupported quotation or verdict.

source-support-sourcespans-items.definition: one selected source-span record, distinct from its support root and from a locator address.
source-support-sourcespans-items.disposition: Keep each selected span distinct from the support root and other spans; dropping it loses assertion-specific selection.

source-support-sourcespans-items-checksu.definition: narrative note that points to recorded hashes or edition identity; it is not itself a checksum.
source-support-sourcespans-items-checksu.disposition: Keep a note as narrative/pointer evidence; do not parse it as a checksum or infer immutable-byte identity.

source-support-sourcespans-items-content.definition: retained quotation or paraphrase/description of selected material; all four pilots explicitly describe paraphrases.
source-support-sourcespans-items-content.disposition: Retain whether selected content is quoted or paraphrased; no retained quote differs from missing content and does not prove fidelity.

source-support-sourcespans-items-context.definition: qualifying context around selected material, including citation and figure limits; it is neither the asserted subject nor a verdict.
source-support-sourcespans-items-context.disposition: Keep qualifications, figure and citation limits adjacent to the selection; dropping context can overstate the span.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: collection of locator references for the selected span.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Preserve all locator references so text and figure addresses remain separate selections rather than one invented address.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: one locator reference; text and figure locators can be jointly selected without making the figure independent proof.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Keep each locator reference and its unresolved fragment semantics; a table-ID lookup is not a demonstrated URL-anchor resolver.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: identifier of a locator target, used with path and revision rather than as a globally unique address.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Use the locator ID to find the named map row, while recording that map rows do not independently declare locator revision or fragment anchors.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: relative record path and optional anchor locating a locator target; resolution alone is not support.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Keep the literal relative path/fragment for a named consumer; without a documented fragment convention it remains an unresolved resolution component.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: revision of a locator target; pilots use numeric 1, a local convention rather than a universal type.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Retain requested numeric revision, but do not treat pilot value 1 as declared by the locator-map target or universally typed.

source-support-sourcespans-items-quotepo.definition: policy distinguishing retained quotation from paraphrase; no quotation retained is neither permission nor fidelity proof.
source-support-sourcespans-items-quotepo.disposition: Preserve the policy because it explains quotation retention, not legal permission or semantic warrant.

source-support-sourcespans-items-selecti.definition: declared narrower material selected from locator context, such as inclusive lines plus a figure; different breadth is not an error.
source-support-sourcespans-items-selecti.disposition: Keep narrower asserted selection boundaries alongside broader locator context; their difference need not be an error.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: reference to the source identity/acquisition record, distinct from snapshot and locator.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Keep source identity reference separate from prepared snapshot and locator; the acquisition text's commit does not declare every requested source tuple component.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: identifier of the source record; pilots use ccn-book, not a claim or span ID.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Retain requested ccn-book ID, but report it unresolved because acquisition has no declared source-record ID.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: path to the source-acquisition record; it resolves relative to a pilot but does not itself establish immutable bytes.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Keep acquisition path as a readable target; path availability plus a commit string is not record identity or immutable-byte verification.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: source-record capture token; pilots use commit-like e0c697b4 while locator and prepared revisions are numeric.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Retain requested e0c697b4 and compare it to the recorded full commit prefix; it is observed correspondence, not a declared source-record revision.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: reference to a source snapshot or representation record bounding inspected material; pilots happen to use a prepared-source manifest, one observed target role.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Treat this as a general snapshot reference; separately record that pilots point to a prepared manifest rather than equating all snapshots with preparation.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: identifier of the referenced snapshot/representation record; pilots use ps-ccn-book-pilot-20260911 for a prepared-source record.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Retain pilot prepared-source ID and its target declaration without promoting this local identifier into universal snapshot semantics.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: path to the referenced snapshot/representation record; pilot paths target a prepared-source manifest.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Keep the manifest path as preparation provenance; it does not independently verify upstream bytes or source-support relation.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: revision of the referenced snapshot/representation record; pilot numeric 1 is the manifest's declared revision, not an upstream byte claim.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Retain manifest revision 1, which is declared for the preparation record but not proof of the upstream source revision.

source-support-sourcespans-items-spanid.definition: local identifier for a selected span; no global uniqueness rule is established.
source-support-sourcespans-items-spanid.disposition: Keep local selected-span identity; do not infer global uniqueness or merge spans by similar content.

source-support-sourcesupportstatus.definition: observed assertion-to-span relation label: template unassessed; pilots candidate-supported or candidate-supported-with-caveat. It is not verification, grade, or an exhaustive vocabulary.
source-support-sourcesupportstatus.disposition: Preserve observed unassessed/candidate labels as scoped relation statements; do not turn them into closed vocabulary, grade, verification, or admission.

source-support-subjectref.definition: reference to the assertion evaluated by support; pilots identify claims, while template conventions also permit an edge or identifiable CQ coverage assertion.
source-support-subjectref.disposition: Keep subject linkage to an assertion and its construct type; a heading text match is a bounded lookup observation, not literal-anchor proof.

source-support-subjectref-id.definition: identifier of the asserted subject, distinct from support root and span IDs; pilot values are claim-* IDs.
source-support-subjectref-id.disposition: Compare requested claim ID with the matching claim heading; retain that embedded claim ID/revision is not separately declared in frontmatter.

source-support-subjectref-path.definition: path and anchor locating the subject declaration; it requires agreement with identifier, type, and revision.
source-support-subjectref-path.disposition: Keep literal card path/fragment and name the unresolved fragment convention rather than silently treating a heading as a Markdown anchor.

source-support-subjectref-recordtype.definition: construct type of the subject; pilots use claim and synthetic conventions illustrate edge/CQ roles.
source-support-subjectref-recordtype.disposition: Retain requested claim type; target cards declare concept-card at root, while claim is only the indicated embedded assertion.

source-support-subjectref-revision.definition: revision of the asserted subject; pilots use numeric 1, a local reference convention rather than a universal datatype.
source-support-subjectref-revision.disposition: Preserve requested claim revision 1 but do not substitute the target card revision for an independently declared claim revision.
